messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

    earlier: Farah is the sole member of Team Dune as of 2025-01-09. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-07-21; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-09]

    earlier: Team Atlas consists of Priya and Tomasz as of 2025. [valid 2025-01-06 to 2025-07-21; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-06]
- The first on-call rotation for Team Atlas goes to Tomasz. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- The product catalog lived with the Cinder team from 2025-01-17 until 2025-10-20, when it moved to the Boreal team. [valid 2025-10-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-20-catalog]
    earlier: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-10-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Tomasz took over the Team Dune on-call shift from Farah on 2025-12-08. [decision; valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
    earlier: Farah is primary on call for Team Dune starting 2025-11-03. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-03]
- Tomasz is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation as of 2025-12-08. [decision; valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
    earlier: Tomasz is off the Team Dune on-call rotation as of 2025-11-03. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-03]
- Page Tomasz for anything this cycle for Team Dune, not Farah, as of 2026-06-03. [decision; valid 2026-06-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-03]
    earlier: Page Farah for anything this cycle for Team Dune, not Tomasz, as of 2026-04-09. [decision; valid 2026-04-09 to 2026-06-03; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-09]
    earlier: Page Tomasz for anything this cycle for Team Dune, not Farah, as of 2026-02-24. [decision; valid 2026-02-24 to 2026-04-09; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-24]
    earlier: Farah is on call for Team Dune this cycle as of 2026-01-22, not Tomasz. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to 2026-02-24; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-22]
    earlier: Tomasz is on call for Team Dune this cycle as of 2026-01-14. [valid 2026-01-14 to 2026-01-22; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-14]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- Diego held the Cinder on-call phone from 2025-11-25 until 2025-12-15, after which Yuki took it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-11-25, with Yuki off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-10-02, with Diego off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-08-29. [decision; valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-02; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]

- Boreal handed billing-api to Team Dune on 2026-03-25. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
